verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own docs show a snooze feature: snoozed messages are scheduled to return to the Inbox at a chosen time, which covers the snooze half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows follow-up reminders that resurface a thread only when nobody replies, which is a distinct conditional capability that time-based snooze does not provide. missing for 10: no-reply follow-up reminders that resurface a thread conditionally, conversation-level (rather than message-level) snooze documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of snooze.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: Snooze messages to just when you need them.
If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
